capture: dv.runners.run_test stages probes in an external temporary Node dependency directory. Schema 7 records resolved harness inputs plus snapshot paths, raw-byte hashes and ordered entries.
normalization: Synthetic project paths and nonce identifiers; absolute and relative probe stack paths are replaced by <tmp>/node_modules/dv-probe via tests.test_vitest_runner.normalize_vitest_fixture. Every fixture is scanned for machine prefixes.

failed-callback.source:
import {test,expect,beforeAll,afterAll,beforeEach,afterEach,onTestFinished} from 'vitest';
test('value', ({onTestFailed}) => { onTestFailed(() => expect(3).toBe(4)); expect(1).toBe(2); });

config_files.setup.mjs: export default () => { throw new Error('setup failed'); };
export default () => () => { throw new Error('teardown failed'); };

config_files.vitest.config.mjs: export default {test: {projects: [{test: {name: 'one', pool: 'forks', include: ['one/*.test.js']}}, {test: {name: 'two', pool: 'threads', include: ['two/*.test.js']}}]}};

config_files.setup.mjs: export default () => () => { throw new Error('root teardown failed'); };

config_files.vitest.config.mjs: export default {plugins: [{name: 'late', closeBundle() { setTimeout(() => Promise.reject(new Error('late rejection')), 0); }}]};
export default {plugins: [{name: 'late', closeBundle() { throw new Error('close failed'); }}]};
export default {plugins: [{name: 'late', closeBundle() { process.on('exit', () => { throw new Error('late exit'); }); }}]};

snapshot-runtime.source:
import {test,expect,beforeAll,afterAll,beforeEach,afterEach,onTestFinished} from 'vitest';
expect.addSnapshotSerializer({test: () => true, serialize: () => { throw Object.assign(new Error('Snapshot mismatched'), {actual: 1, expected: 2}); }}); test('value', () => expect(1).toMatchInlineSnapshot('2'));

concurrent-soft.source:
import {test,expect,beforeAll,afterAll,beforeEach,afterEach,onTestFinished} from 'vitest';
for (const name of ['one', 'two']) test.concurrent(name, async ({expect}) => { await Promise.resolve(); expect.soft(1).toBe(2); });

global_setup_guard: The root configuration and every resolved project reject globalSetup. Root-with-projects and late rejection/close/exit fixtures exercise the guard and exit-time receipt invalidation.
